attack.value: Attack command starts windup; a different command before launch cancels; at launch melee hits and ranged creates a tracking projectile; movement after launch preserves projectile.

attack_speed.value: base attack speed + attack speed ratio × bonus attack speed fraction
attack_speed.conditions: caps and special exceptions not modeled

damage.value: Physical damage uses armor and magic damage uses magic resistance; true damage bypasses these resistances. Resolve penetration, reductions and shields separately.

edge_range.value: basic attacks generally use edge range; distinguish gameplay radius from pathing radius

movement.value: Minions respect unit collision and player-generated terrain; target selection and pathing are independent of render scale.
